metadata.title: CLOPSSEC_ticket_creation
metadata.description: HTTP-triggered Logic App, called by other playbooks, that raises one CLOPSSEC issue (Task, Problem or Incident) from the request body and answers synchronously: 200 with the ticket key and URL, 400 when the request fails validation, 4xx/5xx when Trackspace refuses the issue. Mandatory fields are checked per issue type before any Jira call; custom field ids are resolved by display name at run time. The Logic App's system-assigned managed identity needs a Key Vault access policy with secret 'get' on the vault holding the Trackspace password.
prerequisites: Key Vault secret '<JiraKeyVaultSecretName>' holding the Trackspace service account password.
KeyVault API connection (this template creates it if absent).
metadata.author: CLOPSSEC ticket creation

metadata.description: Name of the Consumption Logic App. Pass it explicitly on every deploy so a redeploy updates this playbook instead of standing up a parallel one with a fresh managed identity.
Azure region of the playbook and its Key Vault API connection.
Key Vault holding the Trackspace service-account password.
Trackspace base URL. Production is https://trackspace.lhsystems.com; use https://int-trackspace.lhsystems.com for INT.
Key Vault secret name storing the Trackspace password.
Project every ticket is raised in.
Issue type names the trigger accepts (matched case-insensitively, sent to Jira in this casing).

Request fields that must be non-empty per issue type, checked before any Jira call. Mirrors the CLOPSSEC create screens: Task and Incident need summary + description, Problem needs summary + subscription. Priority, reporter and assignee are required by Jira too but always have a default.
Priority name sent when the request carries none, per issue type (the create screen defaults).

Assignee login sent when the request carries none. Empty (default) omits the field, so Jira applies the project default assignee; the CLOPSSEC Incident create screen has no assignee field and rejects one. '-1' sends Jira's 'Automatic' explicitly, for issue types whose screen carries the field.
Security level name sent when the request carries none. Empty omits the field so Jira applies the project's default level ('Reporter only' on the CLOPSSEC create screens).
Issue link type name used when linked_issues.keys is given without linked_issues.type. Empty means the request must name the type.

Request field -> Jira custom field map. 'name' is resolved to the customfield_* id at run time via GET /rest/api/2/field; set 'id' to pin it (skips the lookup, disambiguates duplicate names). 'kind' shapes the value: text, select ({value}), insight ([{key}]), checklist ([{name, checked}]), raw (sent as given).

priority.description: Jira priority name (e.g. '3 - Medium') or numeric id (e.g. '10114'). Omit for the per-type default.

Compose_validation_errors.inputs: @union(if(empty(outputs('Compose_issue_type')), array(concat('issue_type must be one of: ', join(parameters('AllowedIssueTypes'), ', '), ' (got: ', trim(string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['issue_type'], ''))), ')')), json('[]')), if(greater(length(body('Filter_missing_mandatory_fields')), 0), array(concat('missing mandatory field(s) for ', outputs('Compose_issue_type'), ': ', join(body('Filter_missing_mandatory_fields'), ', '))), json('[]')), if(and(greater(length(outputs('Compose_issue_links')['keys']), 0), empty(outputs('Compose_issue_links')['type'])), array('linked_issues.type is required when linked_issues.keys is given (or set the DefaultIssueLinkTypeName parameter)'), json('[]')))

inputs.name: Unresolved_Fields
inputs.value: @{items('Foreach_requested_custom_field')?['key']} (Jira field named '@{items('Foreach_requested_custom_field')?['name']}': @{length(body('Select_matching_field_ids'))} custom field(s) with that name in /rest/api/2/field)

body.error: @{concat('request field(s) could not be mapped to a Jira custom field id: ', join(variables('Unresolved_Fields'), '; '), '. Pin the id in the JiraCustomFields parameter of the playbook.')}

Build_optional_fields.inputs: @union(json('{}'), if(empty(outputs('Compose_resolved_defaults')?['priority']), json('{}'), addProperty(json('{}'), 'priority', addProperty(json('{}'), if(isInt(outputs('Compose_resolved_defaults')?['priority']), 'id', 'name'), outputs('Compose_resolved_defaults')?['priority']))), if(empty(trim(string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['fields']?['description'], '')))), json('{}'), addProperty(json('{}'), 'description', string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['fields']?['description'], '')))), if(empty(outputs('Compose_resolved_defaults')?['security_level']), json('{}'), addProperty(json('{}'), 'security', addProperty(json('{}'), 'name', outputs('Compose_resolved_defaults')?['security_level']))), if(empty(trim(string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['fields']?['reporter'], '')))), json('{}'), addProperty(json('{}'), 'reporter', addProperty(json('{}'), 'name', trim(string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['fields']?['reporter'], '')))))), if(empty(outputs('Compose_resolved_defaults')?['assignee']), json('{}'), addProperty(json('{}'), 'assignee', addProperty(json('{}'), 'name', outputs('Compose_resolved_defaults')?['assignee']))), if(equals(length(body('Select_components')), 0), json('{}'), addProperty(json('{}'), 'components', body('Select_components'))), if(equals(length(outputs('Compose_normalized_lists')['labels']), 0), json('{}'), addProperty(json('{}'), 'labels', outputs('Compose_normalized_lists')['labels'])), if(empty(trim(string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['fields']?['due_date'], '')))), json('{}'), addProperty(json('{}'), 'duedate', trim(string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['fields']?['due_date'], ''))))))

Compose_issue_body.inputs: @union(addProperty(json('{}'), 'fields', union(outputs('Build_core_fields'), outputs('Build_optional_fields'), variables('Custom_Fields'))), if(greater(length(body('Select_issue_links')), 0), addProperty(json('{}'), 'update', addProperty(json('{}'), 'issuelinks', body('Select_issue_links'))), json('{}')))

body.error: @{concat('the playbook failed before the ticket could be created: ', join(body('Select_failure_messages'), '; '))}
